description: Left-card composition and design-token/pill pass in src/components/VayuLokLive.tsx: large primary hero photo with additional photos in an internal pager/rail (never floating on the map), the bottom pointer/NOTCH card composition, and a final pill + token audit (fully transparent inactive pills, translucent lime active ~.6, dark-green 3px focus ring, map panel border normalized to the homepage hairline unless a stronger boundary is justified, no resting shadows, lime only as punctuation). Depends on FEAT-002 (built on the null-selectable place state). The design/presentation matrix tests (F, J, L) and the destination-bar section-04 refinements live here. All JSX stays inline for styled-jsx scope; the notch outer-wrapper is high-risk - keep it inline.
steps: SECTION 15/17 - hero photo + notch. In the left place card, make the FIRST visible state one LARGE primary hero photo (not the current 3-up grid as the only presentation). Keep additional photos accessible through the existing internal pager/rail (vl-live-place-photos + vl-live-photo-tabs) - do NOT float a gallery over the map. Preserve the number-only referee-SVG lime pill exactly (the SVG path and aria-label='N place photos' and fill #d1f470 must stay byte-identical). Implement the bottom pointer/NOTCH: wrap the card so an OUTER wrapper has overflow:visible and the INNER card keeps border-radius:14px + overflow:hidden, then draw a centered bottom notch (a rotated square or clip-path triangle) from the outer wrapper. The notch must not break responsive layout (test at narrow + wide). Keep ALL this markup inline in the component return so styled-jsx keeps the vl-live- scope.

SECTION 04 - destination bar refinement. Verify .vl-live-map-destbar matches section 04: strong place NAME, secondary type/locality/short-address when real, right chevron, accessible button semantics, hidden when no selection, inset clear of Google legal, homepage styling (white surface, dark-green text, hairline/dark-green boundary, pill-ish 14px radius, no resting heavy shadow, hover shadow 0 4px 12px rgba(26,58,42,.12)). The current resting box-shadow is 0 2px 10px rgba(26,58,42,.12) - the floating bar may keep a light elevation since it sits over the map, but reduce it toward the homepage 'no resting shadow' rule if it reads as heavy; keep the hover shadow. Change the chevron behavior to focus/scroll the LEFT selected-place card into view (section 04 suggested behavior) in addition to or instead of the current recenter-on-click; wire an onClick that scrolls the left card ref into view and moves focus to it. Keep it a real keyboard-focusable button.

SECTION 11/23 - pill + token audit. Verify and adjust the AQI/PM2.5 selector CSS: inactive .vl-live-layer must be fully transparent (background:transparent, no backdrop-filter, no white fill, no resting shadow, dark-green text, subtle dark-green 1.5px border) - already present, confirm. Active .vl-live-layer[aria-pressed=true] must be TRANSLUCENT lime - currently rgba(209,244,112,.55); the spec names ~rgba(209,244,112,.6) as the target, so set it to rgba(209,244,112,.6) with #1a3a2a text + #1a3a2a border and NO solid/opaque lime. Focus ring must be outline:3px solid #1a3a2a; outline-offset:3px (already present, confirm, and ensure no translucent lime ring remains anywhere). Normalize the MAP PANEL border: .vl-live-map-stage is currently border:1px solid rgba(209,244,112,.92) (lime) - change to the homepage hairline 1px solid #e5e7eb unless a stronger boundary is justified (document the choice). Confirm no resting shadows anywhere in the component CSS (the fallback pin keeps its decorative shadow; map stage box-shadow stays none). Ensure lime is used only as punctuation/active color (number pill, active pill, chevron accent, 3px accent rules), not as a general panel fill or a resting border.

SECTION 03/14 verify (no rebuild) - confirm the hybrid SearchDestinations path still only renders polygon/entrances when Google actually returns them, uses VayuLok no-red styling (dark-green/lime strokes), keeps the base map readable (low-opacity fill), and does not fabricate geometry for localities. Apply the India country check from FEAT-002 to the SearchDestinations resolved location if it exposes one. Document that this branch is only exercisable on a live *.wecare.digital origin.

TESTS (matrix, add/extend behavioral tests in src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx): F - destination bar: absent without a selection; appears after a place is selected; contains the selected destination name; contains secondary context (type or address) when available; the chevron/button is accessible (role button, has an aria-label, is keyboard-focusable); clicking it scrolls/focuses the left card (assert the left card ref receives focus or scrollIntoView is invoked - stub Element.prototype.scrollIntoView). J - pills: inactive pill computed/declared background is transparent with no backdrop-filter; active pill uses translucent lime (assert the active-state rule value is rgba(209,244,112,.6) via the rendered <style> text, matching the existing pill test's approach of reading the styled-jsx CSS text); no Expand/Collapse control exists. L - left card: the photo/count lives in the left card only (no .vl-live-map-photos floating on the map); the pill's visible text is an integer only (not 'N photos'); the exact referee SVG path remains; the required Place Photo author attribution figcaption remains. Keep all existing design/pill/attribution/degradation tests green.

Run npm run typecheck, npm run lint (0 errors), and npx vitest run src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx; fix regressions. Then run the FULL suite `npm run test` once to confirm nothing else in the repo broke.
acceptance_criteria: Left card leads with one large primary hero photo; additional photos stay in the internal pager/rail and never float over the map; the number-only lime pill + exact referee SVG + aria-label are preserved (matrix L)
The card has a clean centered bottom notch via an outer-wrapper (overflow:visible) + inner card (radius:14px overflow:hidden) without breaking responsive layout

Destination bar is hidden without a selection, appears with name + secondary context after selection, is an accessible keyboard-focusable button, and its chevron focuses/scrolls the left card into view (matrix F)

Inactive AQI/PM2.5 pills are fully transparent with no backdrop blur and no resting shadow; active pill is translucent lime rgba(209,244,112,.6) with dark-green text/border; focus ring is 3px solid #1a3a2a offset 3px (matrix J)
Map panel border is the homepage hairline 1px solid #e5e7eb (or a justified stronger boundary, documented); no resting shadows anywhere; lime used only as punctuation/active color
SearchDestinations geometry still only drawn when Google returns it, in no-red styling, with the India country check applied; locality searches draw no fake geometry
No red anywhere; Google logo/legal and Place Photo author attribution remain intact and inset-clear
findings: Done on branch vayulok-selected-place-final (built on FEAT-002 commit ef1cc443). Section 15: left card now leads with one large primary hero photo (.vl-live-photo-hero, 232px, object-fit:cover) carrying its own author-attribution figcaption; additional photos stay in the existing horizontal pager rail (.vl-live-place-photos + .vl-live-photo-tabs), nothing floats on the map. The number-only referee-SVG lime pill is preserved byte-identical (path + aria-label 'N place photos' + fill via --lime #d1f470). Section 17: inner .vl-live-place-card keeps radius:14px+overflow:hidden, wrapped by an OUTER .vl-live-place-cardwrap (overflow:visible) that draws a centred bottom notch (.vl-live-place-notch, 16px square rotated 45deg with hairline edges). All markup kept INLINE so styled-jsx keeps the vl-live- scope (notch verified in both narrow and wide via responsive CSS). Section 04: destbar onClick now scrollIntoView+focus the left card (placeCardRef on the outer wrapper, tabIndex=-1 + focus-visible ring); scrollIntoView guarded with typeof for jsdom; recenter kept as secondary; hidden before selection, present after with name + secondary context; still a keyboard-focusable button clear of Google legal; resting shadow reduced 0 2px 10px .12 -> 0 1px 4px .08 and hover normalized to the homepage token 0 4px 12px rgba(26,58,42,.12). Sections 11/23: active pill fill set to rgba(209,244,112,.6) with #1a3a2a text+border; inactive verified transparent, no backdrop blur, no resting shadow, dark-green text+1.5px border; focus ring 3px solid var(--green) offset 3px kept; map panel border normalized from lime rgba(209,244,112,.92) to homepage hairline 1px solid #e5e7eb (decision recorded), box-shadow:none kept; lime remains punctuation/active only. Section 03/14 verified (not rebuilt): SearchDestinations draws polygon/entrances only when Google returns them, no-red styling, India gate applied upstream, documented as live-only on *.wecare.digital. Tests: added matrix F (destbar absent->present, accessible button, chevron scrollIntoView+focus of left card), J (inactive transparent/no blur, active rgba(209,244,112,.6), dark-green 3px focus ring, map border hairline, no Expand/Collapse), L (photo+integer pill in left card only, no on-map gallery, exact referee SVG path, hero photo leads, author attribution figcaption). Gates: npm run typecheck clean (0 errors); npm run lint 0 errors (204 warnings repo-wide, 9 for the two files, the extra one being an existing-pattern no-img-element warning on the new hero ); npx vitest run src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx 44/44 green (was 41); full npm run test 945 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failed (was 942 passed). No API key committed; Google logo/legal and Place Photo author attribution intact; no red anywhere.
